title: Heavenly Dao Origin
next_chapter_hook: Just as the guardians of the Three Roads were arguing endlessly, an unseen rune emerged in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea—a fourth path that even Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned.

text.content: The commander of the dimensional invaders gazed at Chen Ji. That was no ordinary gaze, but a will projection spanning countless voids and piercing through numerous dimensions. The moment that will touched Chen Ji, every hair on his body stood on end—this was the first time the Tianji Record Fragment had issued a warning, not of 'danger,' but of 'being watched.' For three years, he had walked the world as a waste, and now he was being truly looked upon by an existence at the Heavenly Dao level.

dialogue.content: A waste?" The will projection emanated a silent laugh. "Interesting. Three thousand years ago, there was someone just like you, someone I also truly looked upon in such circumstances—his name was Chen Xuan.

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, his panic frozen at just the right moment, then transformed into deeper bewilderment. But deep in his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment疯狂翻动, countless images flashing like a carousel—Chen Xuan's inheritance, the truth of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, and a secret deliberately hidden for countless ages. In the depths of his pupils, a cold gleam flickered briefly. Noted. When the time comes.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan... who is that?" Chen Ji's voice trembled as he stepped back half a pace. "This junior is merely a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, I implore the senior to investigate!
A servant disciple?" The will projection's amusement grew colder. "Those chosen by the Tianji Record are never servants. That trace of incomplete aura on you can deceive those ants, but not me.

text.content: At that moment, Su Qingyao's figure appeared at Chen Ji's side. Her hand was already on her sword hilt, knuckles white, yet forcing herself not to tremble. She knew what she was facing—an existence beyond her comprehension, where any single thought could crush her. But she did not retreat. Chen Ji had saved her from peril multiple times, and now it was her turn to stand before him.

dialogue.content: If the senior has instructions, Qingyao shall accept them on my junior brother's behalf." Her voice was steady, steady enough to even surprise herself. "Disciples of the Tianqing Sect never wait passively for death.

The will projection glanced at Su Qingyao, as if looking at an ant trying to shake Mount Tai. But in the next moment, its projection slightly solidified—because behind Su Qingyao, Chen Ji's aura had悄然发生变化. A faint Tianji Record fluctuation emanated from within him.

text.content: Enough." Chen Ji's voice suddenly changed. No more panic, no more trembling, but an icy calm that came from his very bones. He raised his head and directly faced that dimensional-spanning will projection for the first time. Su Qingyao turned in惊愕, seeing a completely unfamiliar face—those eyes held the cold indifference of one who had calculated all under heaven.

Chen Ling's will had completed its initial fusion with him. A surge of magnificent power erupted from the Tianji Record Fragment, forming a pale golden light barrier around him. He gazed at the will projection, the corner of his lips slightly lifting into a meaningful smile. Remembering without acting rash—I have noted what you said about Chen Xuan's name. When the time comes, I will make you tell me personally what you did to him.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Dao Origin..." he quietly repeated these four words. "I searched for it for three thousand years, and it was here all along. Senior, have you come to guide me?

text.content: The will projection fell silent. This was its first silence. Then, it slowly raised its hand, and a crack tore open in the void—the depths of that crack revealed a space of primordial chaos, wherein three massive gates floated. The guardians of the Three Roads appeared simultaneously. The left gate burned with sanctifying holy fire; the right gate flowed with corrosive demonic energy; the middle gate was but emptiness.

Three roads, three choices." The will projection's voice echoed through the void. "Left, replace me and become the new Heavenly Dao will; Right, coexist with me and share Heavenly Dao authority; Center, return to nothingness, never again to have your name in the Heavenly Dao cycle.

Chen Ji quietly gazed at the three gates. In his mind, the Tianji Record Fragment flashed frantically, countless images intertwining—he saw Chen Xuan standing in the same position in ages past, saw generations of prophets struggling and falling on these three roads. His fingers trembled slightly. Not from fear, but from rage. For those ancient sages who had been used as chess pieces by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao.

choice.prompt: The guardians of the Three Roads simultaneously extended their hands to Chen Ji, each insisting on their own argument. This was the moment of destiny—which path will you choose?

choices.description: Replace the Eye of Heavenly Dao and become the new Heavenly Dao will. But the fate of the prophetic ancestors told him that this path would cause the inheritor to gradually lose humanity, becoming a new puppet.
choices.risk_hint: All Inheritors Throughout History Have Fallen on This Path

text.content: The guardian of the Holy Fire extended its hand to Chen Ji, and within the flames, the faces of Heavenly Dao inheritors throughout history emerged—without exception, after gaining power, they gradually lost human emotions and became cold enforcers of rules.

dialogue.content: So that's how it is..." Chen Ji said softly. "This is your trap. Letting me believe I could replace you, not knowing that from the moment of replacement, I would become the next you.

choices.description: Coexist with the Eye of Heavenly Dao and share Heavenly Dao authority. But this meant being bound by it forever, becoming its accomplice rather than an independent existence.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Power Resonating with Heavenly Dao

text.content: The guardian of the Demonic Energy extended its hand to Chen Ji, and from within the pitch-black mist came the wails of those who had coexisted with Heavenly Dao throughout history—they gained power but paid with their souls.

dialogue.content: Don't!" Su Qingyao desperately grabbed Chen Ji's wrist. "If you choose this path, I will accompany you. But I beg you, don't!

choices.description: Return to nothingness and completely vanish from the Heavenly Dao cycle. This was the option of escape, but also the only way to preserve the self.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling's Sacrifice Would Be Meaningless

text.content: The Gate of the Void slowly opened, and an air of extinction flowed forth from within. The wills of the prophets throughout history who had chosen this path had long since dissipated in this void.

dialogue.content: Return... return to nothingness..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, and Chen Ling's will violently fluctuated in his Mental Sea, as if weeping and imploring him not to choose this path.

choices.description: Refuse the three predetermined roads, face the core of Heavenly Dao Origin, and challenge this transcendent existence. This was the most dangerous choice, but also the only chance to break the cycle.
choices.visible_reward: May Discover the Truth of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji did not walk toward any gate, but directly stepped forward into the blank space between the three gates. For the first time, an expression changed on the will projection—that was surprise, even a trace of imperceptible fear.

dialogue.content: These three roads, I will take none of them." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "You are the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but the Heavenly Dao Origin... is not necessarily you.

text.content: The will projection's pressure suddenly increased, pressing down on Chen Ji like something substantial. But he did not retreat, nor did he show fear. He merely stood there quietly, feeling that transcendent power while allowing his Mental Sea to fuse even more closely with Chen Ling's will. At the junction of two souls, a unprecedented light was gestating.

dialogue.content: A fourth road..." The will projection's voice turned cold. "Do you think you can step beyond the framework I have set? Since ancient times, countless prophets have tried to break this cycle—they have all failed.

text.content: They all failed because they were all placing their pieces on your chessboard." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire space. "And I... from the very beginning, never intended to play by your rules.

Deep in the Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly violently trembled. Chen Ji saw an image—Chen Xuan's final layout left behind, a secret even the Eye of Heavenly Dao did not know. In that image, Chen Xuan stood before the Heavenly Dao Origin and spoke a sentence: "The Tianji Record is not your chess piece—it is the backup plan."

A meaningful smile slowly spread across Chen Ji's lips. He gazed at the will projection, his eyes holding both mockery and compassion. Three thousand years ago, you trapped Chen Xuan with the same tactics. Three thousand years later, you think I will repeat his mistakes? Noted. When the time comes. For now, let me show you what it feels like to have your own chess piece turn against you.
